props.description: The engine whose search and filter the bar edits (`useCollection`).
props.name: collection

props.description: The accessible name of the search box, for example "Search orders"; the box draws no visible label.
props.name: searchLabel

props.description: Hint text drawn inside the empty search box. It never replaces `searchLabel`.
props.name: searchPlaceholder

props.description:
The ids of the filter's conditions and groups that the data source does not apply, for example ones a server
cannot read (a quick filter's condition id is `quickFilterIdOf(column id)`). Their chips are drawn as warnings,
with the `ui` catalogue's "not applied" words as a tooltip on a warning button beside them.
props.name: unappliedIds

props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
props.name: ref

events.description: Called with the whole next value, or `undefined` to drop the filter.
events.name: onChange

props.description: The filter being edited; its kind picks the editor.
props.name: definition

props.description: What the query holds for the filter, or `undefined` when it holds nothing.
props.name: value
